summary: "Intentional Conversations" is a weekly internal sales-training session for Keller Williams Professionals real estate agents, held at the brokerage's Learning Lab at 48 Grove St, Asheville. Eventbrite listings dress it up in generic community/connection marketing copy, but the actual content is agent skill-building on listing presentations and handling seller objections (e.g. pricing, lockboxes). It is company training with a rotating audience of agents, not a persistent social group.

evidence.note: All 9 listings share near-identical generic marketing copy ("dive deep into meaningful discussions and connect on a whole new level") hosted by Keller Williams Professionals, priced Free, weekly at 48 Grove St.
Tags are AI-generated marketing boilerplate (Realtor Meetup, Real Estate Professionals, Professional Development, Facilitated Conversations) rather than descriptions of a member community.

WebFetch of an earlier listing in the same series reveals the real content: a listing-appointment training session on handling seller objections like pricing and lockbox concerns, at KW's Learning Lab, framed as professional development for agents rather than a public/community event.

General search for the group name plus Asheville surfaces only Keller Williams Professionals' own brokerage pages (site, Facebook, Yelp, LinkedIn, Instagram) with no independent group identity, Facebook group, or Meetup page of its own.
